subject: Problem with structured repeated measurement model

messages.author: 5ef0a4875982a9cc
messages.subject: Problem with structured repeated measurement model
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to implement a repeated measurement model with a structured covariance matrix over the random effects. I have repeated measurements over individuals and the model works fine without the structured covariance matrix. Is there some way around my problem?

repmod <- y ~ 1 + fixedeff + f(ind, model="iid") # Model without structured covariance matrix, each ind has several measurements in y
fit1 <- inla(repmod, data=data, control.compute=list(dic=T)) # Works fine

repmodstr <- 1 + fixedeff + f(ind, model="generic0", Cmatrix=invcov) # Model with structured covariance matrix, invcov is an ordinary numeric matrix of size nind x nind
fit2 <- inla(repmodstr, data=data,control.compute=list(dic=T))
Error in inla(fit2, data = data, control.compute = list(dic = T)) :
  In f(ind): 'covariate' must match 'values',  and both must either be 'numeric', or 'factor'/'character'.


Patrik Waldmann
